scope: Diagnostic XNU entry probe with BCM-only MMIO suppressed and early exception display; no device action
success_requires: PROBE37: mount and first exec continue; side panel IDs220..238 observe native activation/task switch/signature/cleanup. A02D activation errno, A02E signature errno, A02F task switch observed, A030 actual exec return, A032 MAC entry errno; stage-specific fields overwrite old WFE data. ID239 magenta/A02B239 means unreviewed restore task release held, not execution success. Original errors/panic/fallback retained; zero activation alone is not success. Revision33 always renders actual activation/exec/signature post-call values, retains last completed error across fallback; A02C counts init exec attempts. No new endpoint. IDs240..263=exec and dyld calls/continuations. A02E=first nonzero stage call ID per attempt, A032=its raw native return (errno or Mach loader status according to callee), A02C=attempt count. Aggregate activation/exec remain A02D/A030. No forced success or path substitution. Before real init exec, request normal Zlib OSKext lifecycle only when native type4 registration is absent; no direct kmod start or table writes. IDs264/265 observe loading; A02A=actual loader status, A033=actual native type4 registration pointer. All successful stages continue; restore userspace release guard remains. Header call 250 resets row y784 x832..1295. IDs266/267=vn_rdwr_64 call/return, 268/269=MAC read, 270/271=VNOP_READ, 272/273=actual filesystem dispatch, 274/275=swap-file read. Scope requires this exact header caller, TPIDR_EL1 and native frame; return markers require their paired call. A034=last read stage; A035=actual low32 return, all ones while call is pending. These overwrite prior A034/A035 after header entry. No marker proves APFS/decmpfs body completion unless its matching return was observed. Real errors and release guard retained. A036 is actual scoped dispatch x8 at y784; A037 at y812 and ID276 at x832/y808 record only the pinned candidate entry. Header entry clears both fields and ID276. Other targets require separate interpretation; an unlit entry tile does not prove they failed to enter. No filesystem body completion or deadlock is inferred; native errors and release guard remain. A038=last scoped native read body site, A039=last paired raw x0 return (not necessarily errno). IDs277..372 cover prologue continuation, all47 direct/indirect calls and continuations, and RET. No new halt or forced success. Unlit does not imply deadlock. Initialization temporarily uses A034 F901 before A037 reset, F902 before A036 reset, F903 before body state/tile reset, F904 before A038/A039 reset; returns to250 before native call. Minimum snapshot height1040. All47 call/return pairs retained; checkpoints are not CPU stop proofs or a claimed PROBE30 fix. HEX writes each pixel once, without a separate full-field black clear. Final labels/values and all native read/exec continuation observations retained. Reduced writes are not proof of a hardware fix. Revision41 overrides the immediate A038/A039 body display described above: all96 tiles remain immediate; last site/paired raw x0 are buffered and displayed only at native RET. While pending, A038=0 and A039=all ones are initialization values, not body progress. Use the actual lit tiles to identify pending calls. Native continuation/error/release policy unchanged. Center gutter IDs373..440 observe compressed-read entry,33 native call/return pairs and RET; two columns x736..815, y224..1031. Calls cyan, continuations green. No extra body HEX or native stop. Native return and outer APFS/read/exec observations remain required. Shared HEX code preserves pixel values and all observations; unchanged A035 skips redundant rendering, with cache reset before every header. No native lock/error/IRQ/release policy changed. Not a claimed root-cause fix. IDs373..440 use 32x2 strips, not full tiles. All native observations and release guard retained. No cache or lock fix claimed. New interleaved 32x2 strips: magenta entry, amber native call, white paired continuation/return; fetch and fixed type4 callback. Native behavior and release guard unchanged.

policy.halt_before: unreviewed restore task final wait release
policy.condition: native exec task switch arms tracking; switch observed; matching task; clear_final_wait=2

limitations: No output is guaranteed after pmap removes the diagnostic framebuffer mapping
TPIDR_EL1 shim is an intentional behaviour change, distinct from transparent hooks
Stage tiles and field IDs must be read using this revision layout

dense_bootstrap.semantics: call means before native BL; continuation means the native post-call address executed, possibly from another predecessor; each site drawn once
limitations: Later kernel framebuffer writes may overwrite the panel
No event ordering or call count is inferred from the cumulative grid

native_vector_handoff.reason: Return normal IRQ/FIQ/synchronous handling to the pinned native XNU vectors before thread services unmask interrupts

display_readback.meaning: CPU readback only; zero does not prove physical scanout is correct

image4_launch_context.policy: 32-bit LE 1: prohibit mix-n-match; no default/empty property

root_mount_diagnostic.mode: Hold only unreviewed restore userspace task release

markers.264: blue load requested or yellow already registered
markers.265: API returned or registration already present; inspect real status/pointer

read_boundaries.scope: Exact header caller LR, TPIDR_EL1 and native caller frames; reset each header attempt

read_dispatch.scope: actual scoped dispatch x8; entry observation only for one fixed static candidate
limitations: Different target without A037 does not prove missing target entry
No lock, IRQ or filesystem body qualification

checkpoints.F901: before A037 reset; entry tile already cleared
checkpoints.F902: A037 reset completed; before A036 reset
checkpoints.F903: A036 reset completed; before body state and tile reset
checkpoints.F904: body state and tiles reset; before A038/A039 reset

read_grid.hex_policy: A038/A039 initialized at header; buffered body state displayed only at native RET

read_decmp.scope: active header, thread, VNOP/APFS frame chain, native LR, outer pair8, own call pairing

read_fetch.scope: active header/thread/target, outer pairs, decmp-fetch-callback frame and LR chain, actual callback x8, own pairs
